SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Ignore prices in shops

2. Which statement about Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain as rumours only.
   B. Explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

4. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.

5. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   B. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.
   D. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.

7. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   C. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   D. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   C. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.
   B. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.
   C. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe.
   B. Treat Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe as rumours only.
   C. Say Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.
   C. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Early Civilisation ● Asia, ● Europe and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Population Growth in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Diversity and interpersonal skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
